Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`), estVoice (s: the predicted voice length, tools/estimate.py; replaced by the real voice once tools/voice.py has run).

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Shakuntala sub-parva. CHECKED AGAINST CE 1.68.1–19 (GRETIL e-text of the constituted text, lab/ce; star passages and appendix lines are apparatus and were not used; Ganguli (vulgate) only as a reading aid): when Duhshanta had gone back after his promise, Shakuntala bore a boy of boundless energy after three full years (1.68.1–2: `born`; the three years are on a plaque); Kanva performed his birth rites (1.68.3); white pointed teeth, a lion's build, palms marked with the wheel, a great head; he grew quickly (1.68.4: `grew`); only six years old, he bound tigers, lions, boars, elephants and buffalo to the trees round Kanva's hermitage, and ran about mounting them, taming them, playing (1.68.5–6: the hook and `tied`); the dwellers in Kanva's hermitage named him Sarvadamana, because he tames all (1.68.7: `named`); the seer, seeing the boy and his more-than-human deeds, told Shakuntala it was time for him to be young king (1.68.9: `time`); Kanva told his students: take Shakuntala and her son to her husband today; a woman's long stay among her kin is not approved (1.68.10–11: `time`, second sentence; the reason is not voiced); they set out, with her and her son in front, for the city named after the elephant (1.68.12: `walk`; Gajasahvaya is Hastinapura); she was announced and brought in with her son, bright as the young sun (1.68.14: `court`); she honoured the king and said: this is your son; consecrate him young king; act by the agreement you made at Kanva's hermitage; remember it (1.68.15–17: `claim`; the consecration is not voiced); the king heard her and, although he remembered (smarann api), said: I do not remember; whose are you, wicked ascetic woman; I recall no tie of law, love or gain with you; go or stay as you like (1.68.18–19: `knew` and the cliffhanger). CE AGAINST THE POPULAR STORY: the king does not forget; there is no ring and no curse (those are Kalidasa's play). The escort of students is in the CE (1.68.12); its return to the hermitage before the scene in court is appendix material and is not shown either way.
structure: As from episode 41 (script/ARC-41-50.md, script/ARC-51-60.md): COLD OPEN (≤ 8 words; the hook style rotates and never repeats the episode before; no episode of this batch opens on fire) → title (hook post) → STORY from ≈ 4.5 s with the UNVOICED recap band → the episode stands alone (every name has an identifier in "names", shown as a plaque) → one question closed (loop.answeredBy), the previous one answered by 15 s (loop.prevAnsweredBy) → turn at 40–60 % after a real silence, a second silence where the story allows → one face close-up with a change of emotion → one signature shot → the cliffhanger with the source line → a ≤ 1.2 s NEXT › band that dissolves into frame 1. Per line: pal (the colour script: no hue for more than two lines), cam (≥ 4 distinct moves), tr (transitions born from the medium), amb / foley / music (three sound layers; ambLead / ambLag = J- and L-cuts). Gate: tools/gate.mjs.

names.Kanva: a great sage, her foster father

loop.hookQuestion: Who was the boy of six who tied lions to trees?
loop.prevQuestion: What became of Shakuntala and her son in the forest?
loop.openQuestion: What will Shakuntala say to a king who denies her?

strings.recapLine: A king married Shakuntala in the forest and promised their son his throne.

lines.text: A boy of six tied lions to trees.
lines.say: A boy of six [p:100] tied lions to trees.
lines.note: COLD OPEN (a count; no fire): a small boy's back, close, a rope over his shoulder; a pull back shows what the rope holds: a great maned lion tied to a tree, yawning, and beyond it a tiger tied to the next. The card in the upper third, clear of the beasts.

lines.text: In a forest hermitage, Shakuntala bore a king's son.
lines.say: In a forest hermitage, [p:100] Shakuntala [p:60] bore a king's son.
lines.note: STORY 0 with the unvoiced recap band (top): the hermitage at morning: Shakuntala seated at the hut's door with a swaddled new-born in her arms (an infant; she is drawn slim: the child is born) (plaques: Shakuntala · the sage Kanva's foster daughter; sub: after three full years · Adi 1.68.2). Answers episode 55's question by 5 s.

lines.text: He grew fast, built like a lion.
lines.say: He grew fast, [p:100] built like a lion.
lines.note: STORY 1 · THE CLOSE-UP (island-gold): the boy's face fills the frame, bright-eyed, a child's round face and curls: curiosity, then a wide fearless grin; he lifts an open palm into the frame beside his face: on it a small gold wheel (tag: the wheel's mark on his palm · Adi 1.68.4).

lines.text: He bound tigers, lions, boars and elephants to the trees, and rode them.
lines.say: He bound tigers, [p:60] lions, [p:60] boars [p:60] and elephants to the trees, [p:200] and rode them.
lines.note: STORY 2 · THE SIGNATURE SHOT (noon-ochre): a long lateral track down a line of great trees: a tiger tied to one, a lion to the next, a boar, an elephant; and the boy, small, riding the lion's back across the frame, arms out, hermits flattening themselves against the huts. All beasts stand well above the caption band.

lines.text: The hermits named him Sarvadamana: tamer of all.
lines.say: The hermits named him [p:80] Sarvadamana: [p:200] tamer of all.
lines.note: STORY 3 · NEW LIGHT (river-jade; answers the hook): the boy stands on a rock among seated hermits who look up at him, one with a hand to his own head (plaque: SARVADAMANA · "tamer of all"). A slow orbit.

lines.speaker: kanva
lines.text: "It is time he was made crown prince. Take them to the king today."
lines.say: It is time [p:80] he was made crown prince. [p:300] Take them to the king [p:60] today.
lines.note: STORY 4 · THE TURN (≈ 45 %) after a real silence (meadow-spring): the old sage, grave, watching the boy off-frame; then he turns to Shakuntala and two young students and points down the path (plaque: Kanva · a great sage, her foster father). The word of the turn: TIME.

lines.text: Mother and son set out for Hastinapura.
lines.say: Mother and son [p:60] set out for Hastinapura.
lines.note: STORY 5 · NEW LIGHT (riverbank-pearl): a crane up: Shakuntala and the boy on a road beside a pale river, two students with staffs behind; ahead, far, the walls and elephant gate of a great city (plaque: Hastinapura · "the city of the elephant").

lines.text: She was led before the king, her son bright as the sun.
lines.say: She was led before the king, [p:150] her son [p:60] bright as the sun.
lines.note: STORY 6 · NEW LIGHT (dice-vermilion: a court in red and gold): seen between two dark pillars: the long hall, courtiers in rows, the throne high at the far end with the crowned king (plaque: Dushyanta · a king of Puru's line); she walks up the middle in bark cloth, small and straight, the boy's hand in hers, a light about him.

lines.speaker: shakuntala
lines.text: "King, this is your son. Remember your promise."
lines.say: King, [p:100] this is your son. [p:300] Remember your promise.
lines.note: STORY 7: she at the foot of the throne steps, a hand on the boy's shoulder, looking up; the boy looks at the king with open curiosity; the king's hands tighten on the arms of the throne.

lines.text: The king remembered everything. But he said:
lines.say: The king remembered everything. [p:500] But he said:
lines.note: STORY 8 (a second real silence before it; war-iron: the hall darkens round him): the king's face, near: recognition (the eyes widen and go to the boy), then the face shuts (tag: "though he remembered" · Adi 1.68.18).

lines.speaker: dushyanta
lines.text: "I remember nothing. Whose are you, wicked woman?"
lines.say: I remember nothing. [p:350] Whose are you, [p:100] wicked woman?
lines.note: NEXT 1 (CE 1.68.18–19): the king stands, an arm thrown out toward the door; a pull back down the hall: she has not moved; the courtiers' heads all turn to her. The source line (top).
The NEXT › band over the cliffhanger image, with the source line; dissolve into frame 1.
